# Rogue Tap

> Rogue Tap makes reusable NFC tap-to-share cards for UK businesses: digital business cards, plus countertop Google Review and TripAdvisor review plates. Tap a phone against the card and contact details, socials, or a review page open instantly - no app required, works on Android and iPhone.

## Products
- Business card (£19.99 one-time + £3.00/quarter to keep it rewritable): name, title, company, phone, email, website, socials.
- 2 business cards (£29.99 one-time + £4.50/quarter): second card half price.
- Google Review card/plate (£19.99 one-off, no subscription): taps straight to a business's Google Review page.
- TripAdvisor Review card/plate (£19.99 one-off, no subscription): same idea, for TripAdvisor.
